cards.ex: Her language proficiency improved dramatically after she spent a year abroad.
cards.exUz: Chet elda bir yil yashagandan so'ng, uning til bilimi keskin yaxshilandi.
cards.uzDef: Tilni qanchalik yaxshi bilishingiz, unda qanchalik erkin gaplasha olishingiz.

cards.ex: Children typically acquire a language through immersion and interaction.
cards.exUz: Bolalar odatda tilni muhitga tushib va muloqot orqali o'rganadilar.
cards.uzDef: Tilni asta-sekin, tabiiy ravishda o'rganish, o'zlashtirish.

cards.ex: I'm taking this course to hone my skills in data analysis.
cards.exUz: Men ma'lumotlarni tahlil qilish bo'yicha mahoratimni oshirish uchun bu kursga yozildim.
cards.uzDef: Mavjud mahoratni yaxshilash, yanada mukammallashtirish.

cards.ex: He had a thirst for knowledge that drove him to read constantly.
cards.exUz: Uning bilimga chanqoqligi uni doimo o'qishga undadi.
cards.uzDef: Bilishga, o'rganishga bo'lgan kuchli istak, qiziqish.

cards.ex: She's fluent in Spanish and French.
cards.exUz: U ispan va frantsuz tillarida erkin gapiradi.
cards.uzDef: Tilda bemalol, to'xtalmasdan gapira olish.

cards.ex: My mother tongue is Uzbek, but I also speak Russian.
cards.exUz: Mening ona tilim o'zbek tili, lekin rus tilida ham gaplasha olaman.
cards.uzDef: Inson tug'ilib o'sgan, birinchi o'rgangan tili.

cards.ex: There's a bit of a learning curve with this software, but it's worth it.
cards.exUz: Bu dastur bilan ozgina o'rganish jarayoni bor, lekin bunga arziydi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi narsani o'rganishda qiyinchilik va vaqt talab qilinishi.

cards.ex: The language barrier made it difficult to communicate with the locals.
cards.exUz: Til to'sig'i mahalliy aholi bilan muloqot qilishni qiyinlashtirdi.
cards.uzDef: Turli tillarda gapiruvchilar o'rtasidagi muloqotdagi qiyinchilik.

cards.ex: She considers herself a lifelong learner, always taking new courses.
cards.exUz: U o'zini umrbod o'rganuvchi deb hisoblaydi, doimo yangi kurslarga yoziladi.
cards.uzDef: Doimiy ravishda yangi narsalarni o'rganishga intiladigan inson.

cards.ex: His linguistic skills are impressive; he speaks five languages.
cards.exUz: Uning til qobiliyatlari hayratlanarli; u beshta tilda gapiradi.
cards.uzDef: Tillarni o'rganish va ulardan foydalanish qobiliyati.

cards.ex: She seems to pick up languages very easily.
cards.exUz: U tillarni juda oson o'rganadiganga o'xshaydi.
cards.uzDef: Tilni oson va tezda, ko'p harakat qilmasdan o'rganish.

cards.ex: To learn a language quickly, immerse yourself in the culture.
cards.exUz: Tilni tez o'rganish uchun o'zingizni madaniyatga cho'ktiring.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir bilan to'liq shug'ullanib, o'zingni berib yuborish.

cards.ex: He's trying to improve his skills in a foreign tongue.
cards.exUz: U xorijiy tildagi qobiliyatini yaxshilashga harakat qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Ona tili bo'lmagan, chet el tili.

cards.ex: Many students choose to study abroad to broaden their horizons.
cards.exUz: Ko'p talabalar dunyoqarashini kengaytirish uchun chet elda o'qishni tanlaydilar.
cards.uzDef: O'z mamlakatidan tashqarida, xorijda ta'lim olish.

cards.ex: It's helpful to practice with a native speaker.
cards.exUz: Ona tilida so'zlovchi bilan mashq qilish foydali.
cards.uzDef: Ona tili o'sha til bo'lgan inson.

cards.ex: It's important to keep abreast of the latest research in your field.
cards.exUz: O'z sohangizdagi so'nggi tadqiqotlardan xabardor bo'lib turish muhim.
cards.uzDef: So'nggi yangiliklardan, o'zgarishlardan xabardor bo'lib turish.

cards.ex: The test assesses your reading comprehension skills.
cards.exUz: Test sizning o'qishni tushunish qobiliyatingizni baholaydi.
cards.uzDef: Matnni o'qib, uning ma'nosini tushunish qobiliyati.

cards.ex: Employers often look for candidates with strong writing proficiency.
cards.exUz: Ish beruvchilar ko'pincha kuchli yozish mahoratiga ega nomzodlarni qidiradilar.
cards.uzDef: Yozma ravishda o'z fikrini aniq va ravon ifoda eta olish.

cards.ex: Effective verbal communication is crucial in any workplace.
cards.exUz: Samarali og'zaki muloqot har qanday ish joyida juda muhimdir.
cards.uzDef: So'zlar orqali fikr almashish, gaplashish jarayoni.

cards.ex: Pay attention to non-verbal cues during the presentation.
cards.exUz: Taqdimot paytida noverbal ishoralarga e'tibor bering.
cards.uzDef: So'zlarsiz, tana harakatlari, imo-ishoralar orqali ifodalash.

cards.ex: After years of practice, speaking English became second nature to her.
cards.exUz: Ko'p yillik mashqdan so'ng, ingliz tilida gapirish uning uchun ikkinchi tabiatga aylandi.
cards.uzDef: Osonlik bilan bajariladigan, odatiy holatga aylangan narsa.

cards.ex: I lost my train of thought because of the loud noise.
cards.exUz: Qattiq shovqin tufayli fikrimni yo'qotdim.
cards.uzDef: Gapirayotganda yoki o'ylayotganda fikrini yo'qotib qo'yish.

cards.ex: He can articulate clearly even under pressure.
cards.exUz: U hatto bosim ostida ham fikrlarini aniq ifodalay oladi.
cards.uzDef: Fikrlarni tushunarli, ravon va aniq qilib ifodalash.

cards.ex: A well-rounded education prepares you for a variety of careers.
cards.exUz: Har tomonlama ta'lim sizni turli xil kasblarga tayyorlaydi.
cards.uzDef: Turli sohalarni qamrab olgan, keng ko'lamli ta'lim.

cards.ex: Rote learning is not as effective as understanding the concepts.
cards.exUz: Faqat yodlash tushunish kabi samarali emas.
cards.uzDef: Ma'nosini tushunmasdan, faqat yodlash orqali o'rganish.

cards.ex: She likes to think aloud when solving problems.
cards.exUz: U muammolarni hal qilishda o'ylayotgan narsalarini baland ovozda aytishni yaxshi ko'radi.
cards.uzDef: O'ylayotgan narsalarni baland ovozda aytish.

cards.ex: She's multilingual, speaking English, French, and German.
cards.exUz: U ko'p tilli, ingliz, frantsuz va nemis tillarida gapiradi.
cards.uzDef: Bir nechta tillarda bemalol gaplasha oladigan inson.

cards.ex: It's important to understand grammar rules to write correctly.
cards.exUz: To'g'ri yozish uchun grammatika qoidalarini tushunish muhim.
cards.uzDef: Tilning tuzilishini belgilaydigan qoidalar to'plami.

cards.ex: Language acquisition is easier for children than adults.
cards.exUz: Bolalar uchun til o'rganish kattalarga qaraganda osonroq.
cards.uzDef: Tilni tabiiy ravishda, ongsiz ravishda o'zlashtirish jarayoni.

cards.ex: Use context clues to guess the meaning of unfamiliar words.
cards.exUz: Noma'lum so'zlarning ma'nosini taxmin qilish uchun kontekstual ma'lumotlardan foydalaning.
cards.uzDef: Matndagi so'zlarning ma'nosini tushunishga yordam beradigan ma'lumotlar.
